## Validation Commands Level 2's own post-block prose says: "the pinned-substring block PASSES on the current unmodified tree ... After all 6 tasks land: both blocks PASS" — but two of that block's own grep lines can never match: `grep -qE '`seat`.the[[:space:]]+value[[:space:]]+read[[:space:]]+in[[:space:]]+step[[:space:]]+1'` and `grep -qE '`preflight_confirmed`.`true`[[:space:]]+when[[:space:]]+the[[:space:]]+user[[:space:]]+gave[[:space:]]+an[[:space:]]+explicit[[:space:]]+affirmative[[:space:]]+reply'` each use a single-character `.` wildcard to bridge the gap after the field's closing backtick, but the real on-disk text at relay-design-map.md:350 and :355 reads "`seat` — the value read in step 1" and "`preflight_confirmed` — `true` when the user gave" — a 3-character ' — ' (space, em-dash, space) gap, not 1 — so neither grep can ever match, before OR after all 6 tasks land (Task 5 explicitly forbids touching these two lines), directly contradicting the block's own 'both blocks PASS' claim.

## NOT Building (Scope Limits) says: "Resuming an interrupted/truncated library search (step 2) at sub-call granularity... When a prior run's own inventory is itself incomplete (inventory_truncated: true), a resumed run re-issues the search from the start rather than resuming mid-enumeration — a known, documented limitation." — but Task 6's ACTION instructs the FAILED_FIGMA_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED blockquote's replacement sentence to state re-running "now costs only the delta because Phase B steps 2 and 5 automatically skip work already recorded on disk" with no carve-out for a quota exhaustion that struck during step 2 itself (one of Phase B's own two 'load-bearing' calls per that same blockquote's scope) — the new HALT-message guidance unconditionally promises 'costs only the delta' for a scenario (mid-search interruption) the plan's own NOT-Building section admits requires a full re-search, not a delta-only resume.

## Acceptance Criteria AC-A2 says: "Given a fully-cached prior run (inventory_truncated: false, enrichment_truncated: false, no --refresh), when the command is re-invoked, then it issues zero search_design_system calls (Task 2) and zero get_metadata calls (Tasks 3-4) — zero Figma data calls in total" (restating PRD AC-14's own "a fully-cached re-run issues zero Figma calls in total") — but Phase B step 6, unmodified by any of Tasks 1-6, says: "Call `get_code_connect_map` for the library. This call is opportunistic...", and step 1 names the only three quota-exempt tools as "`whoami`, `add_code_connect_map`, `generate_figma_design`" — `get_code_connect_map` (step 6, a READ, distinct from the exempt WRITE `add_code_connect_map`) is NOT exempt and fires unconditionally on every run with no skip/cache logic added anywhere in this plan, so a 'fully-cached' re-run still issues at least one non-exempt Figma call, contradicting AC-A2's own 'zero Figma data calls in total' claim.
